note: Fact cards (M1-07, #17). Each card is one query to the open-data-atl `query_dataset` tool and one line of text. `at` is [x, z] in level meters on the Eastside Trail; the game puts the card on the ground there. A template field is {FIELD} (the first row), {round:FIELD}, {count} (the row count), or {list:FIELD} (the sorted values). Run `node scripts/fetch-facts.mjs` to record the fixture again.

cards.template: The Eastside Trail links {count} neighborhoods here: {list:NAME}.
{NAME} covers {round:GIS_AC} acres of city park land.
{list:STATION} MARTA rail station is within a mile of the trail.
